arena_run.reason: SpellBench disk-reserve guard requires 60 GiB; development filesystem had approximately 6 GiB free. Official conformance games did execute.

golden_transcripts: Inspected, not replayed as Forge tests: the upstream fake-engine identities and scenario states are engine-specific.
scope: Experimental six-catalog land, burn and creature pool, two external seats, BO1, host_assigned start, mulligan none/London, declared Forge autopay and combat damage order. Not general card support.
execution: All 21 official checks invoked via the unmodified check_engine API with only=[name], one check at a time. The games check ran 12 seat-swapped first/uniform games, two per catalog, with auto resolving to London mulligans.

adapter_integration_tests.coverage: Natural burn and combat wins, complete burn and green-combat raw-public-API vs adapter priority traces and outcomes, multiple blockers and Forge damage allocation, haste, creature targets, London ordered bottoming through a zero-card starting hand, deterministic replay with unequal decks and p1 starting. Execution: 32 unit/integration tests together, then the added unequal-deck replay test separately; all 33 unique tests passed.

build_artifacts.assets_provenance: Reused pre-existing local framed archive. All 13 admitted card scripts match the pinned Forge source, ignoring boundary whitespace. Normal documented build regenerates the archive.

limitations: Published Forge-WASM 0.2.0 is incompatible; rebuild with optional session fields, spellCard/firstTurnControlled/isBlocking projections, wrapper failure propagation and the harness London boundary fix.

Only the six audited catalogs are supported. No arbitrary decklists, coupled combat restrictions, complex target requirements, modes/X, triggered/non-mana activated abilities, replacement choices or random card effects.
Target slot 0 and null modes/X/divisions rely on audited closed-catalog scripts, not general prompt metadata.
No general randomness/noninterference or native object-incarnation guarantee outside the admitted catalogs.
The standalone Arena ledger run was blocked by the upstream disk-reserve guard. The official conformance host games executed and completed naturally.
No full repository lint/typecheck gate was run; scoped checks are listed above.
